scope: V1 Scheduler token budget, request admission, queue ordering, KV allocation and preemption.

claims.claim: V1 Scheduler uses a unified per-step token budget and tracks each request's computed-token progress; the same scheduling loop can cover prefill, decode, chunked prefill, prefix caching and speculative decoding.
claims.notes: This does not mean all requests are treated identically; running and waiting requests follow different admission paths.

claims.claim: The current V1 schedule method processes Running requests first and then attempts to schedule Waiting requests if the step has budget and no blocking preemption condition.
claims.locator: schedule: Running loop around lines 778–1040; Waiting loop after line 1040
claims.notes: The full implementation contains many additional branches for connectors, multimodal inputs, speculative decoding and pauses.

claims.claim: max_num_batched_tokens bounds token work in one iteration; max_num_scheduled_tokens is the scheduler-issued token cap and usually matches but may be smaller; max_num_seqs sizes per-iteration request capacity and max_num_active_seqs can lower active admission.
claims.notes: Resolved values depend on EngineArgs, platform, model and runtime mode.

claims.claim: V1 supports FCFS and Priority scheduling. Lower numeric priority values are handled earlier; priority scheduling selects the highest numeric priority and latest arrival time as a lower-priority preemption candidate.
claims.locator: SchedulingPolicy initialization and priority preemption selection
claims.notes: Priority does not by itself provide tenant quotas or strict fairness.

claims.claim: When KV allocation cannot proceed, V1 may preempt a running request, free its KV blocks, reset computed-token progress and place it back in the waiting queue for later recomputation or prefix reuse.
claims.notes: Prefix Cache or a KV connector may recover some work on re-admission; recomputation is not the same as swapping the request state to CPU.

claims.claim: PREEMPTED is not a terminal RequestStatus; RequestStatus.is_finished treats statuses after PREEMPTED as finished.
claims.notes: RequestStatus enum values are internal implementation details and may change.
